9
Yesu soma asuafoɔ dummienu no
(Mateo 10.1-15; Marko 6.7-13)
1Na ɔfrɛɛ dummienu no hyiae, maa wɔn ahonhommɔne nyinaa ne ayaresa so tumi ne ahoɔden. 2Na ɔsomaa wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔka Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm, na wɔnsa yadeɛ. 3Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommfa biribiara nntu kwan, mommfa poma anaa bɔtɔ anaa aduane anaa sika anaa ntadeɛ mmienu mmienu. 4#Luk 10.5-7 Na efie biara a mobɛkɔ mu no, ɛhɔ ara na montena, na moafiri hɔ akɔ. 5#Luk 10.11 Na wɔn a wɔrennye mo no, mofiri kurom hɔ rekɔ a, momporoporo mo nan ase mfuturo mfa nni adanseɛ ntia wɔn. 6Na wɔsii mu hɔ faa nkuraa nyinaa ase mmaako mmaako kaa asɛmpa no, na wɔsaa yadeɛ baabiara.
Herode pɛ sɛ ɔhunu Yesu
(Mateo 14.1-2; Marko 6.14-16)
7Na ɔmansinihene Herode tee deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa; na ne tiri mu yɛɛ no keserenee sɛ ebinom se: Wɔanyane Yohane afiri awufoɔ mu, 8na ebinom se: Elia ayi ne ho akyerɛ, na afoforɔ se: Tete adiyifoɔ no mu baako asɔre. 9#Luk 23.8 Na Herode kaa sɛ: Yohane deɛ, matwa ne ti, na hwan ne oyi a mete ne ho nsɛm a ɛte sɛɛ yi? Na ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔhu no.
Nnipa mpemnum aduanema
(Mateo 14.13-21; Marko 6.30-44; Yohane 6.1-13)
10Na asomafoɔ no sane bae, na wɔbɛkaa deɛ wɔakɔyɛ nyinaa kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔfaa wɔn de wɔn kɔɔ afa baabi, kuro a wɔfrɛ no Betsaida no ho. 11Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no hunuiɛ no, wɔdii n’akyi; na ɔgyee wɔn kaa wɔn Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm, na ɔsaa wɔn a ɛhia ayaresa no yadeɛ. 12Na adeɛ reyɛ asa; na dummienu no ba bɛsee no sɛ: Gya nkurɔfokuo no kwan na wɔnkɔ nkuro ne nkuraase a atwa ahyia yi so nkɔtena hɔ, na wɔanya aduane; na baabi a yɛwɔ yi yɛ ɛserɛ so. 13Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momma wɔn biribi nni! Na wɔse: Yɛnni biribiara sɛ paanoo nnum ne mpataa mmienu pɛ, gye sɛ yɛkɔtɔ aduane ma nkurɔfoɔ yi nyinaa. 14Na wɔbɛyɛ mmarima mpemnum. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: Momma wɔntenatena ase akuakuo bɛyɛ aduonum aduonum. 15Na wɔyɛɛ saa, na wɔmaa wɔn nyinaa tenatenaa ase. 16Na ɔfaa paanoo nnum ne mpataa mmienu no hwɛɛ ɔsoro hyiraa so, na ɔbubu de maa asuafoɔ no sɛ wɔnkyɛ mma nkurɔfokuo no. 17#2 Ah 4.44 Na wɔdii, na wɔn nyinaa meemee, na wɔtasee mporoporowa a ɛkaeɛ no nkɛntɛn dummienu.
Petro paemuka
(Mateo 16.13-28; Marko 8.27—9.1)
18Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔno nko wɔ hɔ rebɔ mpaeɛ no, na n’asuafoɔ no ka ne ho; na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no se: Mene hwan? 19Na wɔbuaa sɛ: Yohane suboni, na ebinom se: Elia, na afoforɔ se: Tete adiyifoɔ no mu bi na wasɔreɛ. 20Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Mo deɛ, mose mene hwan? Na Petro buaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn Kristo no.
Yesu hyɛ ne wuo ne ne wusɔreɛ ho nkɔm
21Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ketee, baraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnka yei nnkyerɛ obiara 22#Luk 9.44; 18.32-33 sɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ Onipa Ba no hunu amane pii, na mpanimfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ apo no, na wɔakum no, na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wanyane.
Ahopakyire
23Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn nyinaa sɛ: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔdi m’akyiri a, ɔmpa ne ho akyi, na ɔmfa n’asɛnnua daa, na ɔnni m’akyi. 24#Luk 17.33; Mat 10.39; Yoh 12.25 Na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛgye ne kra no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa, na deɛ me nti ne kra bɛfiri ne nsa no, ɔbɛgye no nkwa. 25Na sɛ onipa nya wiase nyinaa, na ɔyera anaasɛ ɔhwere ne ho a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɔbɛnya? 26#Mat 10.33 Na obiara a n’ani bɛwu me ne me nsɛm ho no, ɔno nso ho bɛyɛ Onipa Ba no aniwu ɛda a ɔde ɔno ne n’agya ne n’abɔfoɔ kronkron animuonyam bɛba no. 27Na nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Wɔn a wɔgyina ha yi mu binom wɔ hɔ a, wɔrenka owuo nhwɛ kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie ansa.
Yesu animuonyam hran
(Mateo 17.1-9; Marko 9.2-9)
28Na ɛbaa sɛ nsɛm yi akyi bɛyɛ nnawɔtwe no, ɔfaa Petro ne Yohane ne Yakobo, na ɔne wɔn kɔɔ bepɔ so mpaebɔ. 29Na ɔrebɔ mpaeɛ no, n’anim tebea sakyerae, na n’atadeɛ yɛɛ fitaa, na ɛhrann. 30Na hwɛ, mmarima baanu a ɛyɛ Mose ne Elia ne no bɛkasae; 31#Luk 9.22 na wɔyii wɔn ho adi animuonyam mu, na wɔkaa ne wuo a ɔbɛwu wɔ Yerusalem ho asɛm. 32Na nna afa Petro ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho no; na wɔnyaneeɛ no, wɔhunuu n’animuonyam no ne mmarima baanu no sɛ wɔne no gyina hɔ. 33Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔrefiri ne nkyɛn akorɔ no, Petro ka kyerɛɛ Yesu sɛ: Owura, ɛyɛ sɛ yɛtena ha, na ma yɛmmɔ asese mmiɛnsa, wo deɛ baako, Mose deɛ baako, na Elia deɛ baako; ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnnim deɛ ɔreka. 34Na ɔreka saa no, mununkum ba bɛkataa wɔn so; na wɔrekɔ mununkum no mu no, wɔsuroe. 35#Luk 3.22 Na ɛnne bi firii mununkum no mu kaa sɛ: Oyi ne me ba a mayi no, montie no! 36Na ɛnne no twaa mu no, wɔhunuu Yesu nko ara. Na wɔmuamuaa so, na nna no mu no, wɔanka nnoɔma a wɔhunuiɛ no ankyerɛ obiara.
Abɔfra twafoɔ bio ayaresa
(Mateo 17.14-23; Marko 9.14-32)
37Na ɛbaa sɛ adeɛ kyeeɛ a wɔfiri bepɔ no so sii fam no, nkurɔfokuo bebree bɛhyiaa no. 38Na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri nkurɔfoɔ no mu teaa mu sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mesrɛ wo, hwɛ me ba yi, na ɔyɛ me ba korɔ. 39Na hwɛ, honhom bi kye no, na ɔfu mu tea mu su, na ɛsensene no ma n’ano twa ahuro, na ɔbu fa so, na ɛdene no ansa na agyaa no. 40Na mesrɛɛ w’asuafoɔ no sɛ wɔntu no, nanso wɔantumi. 41Na Yesu buaa sɛ: O ɛnnɛ mma a wɔnni gyidie na wɔakyeakyea, mentena mo nkyɛn na mento me bo ase mo ho nkɔduru da bɛn? Fa wo ba no bra ha! 42#Luk 7.15 Na ɔreba no, honhommɔne no himm no hwee fam, na ɛsensenee no. Na Yesu teateaa honhom fi no, na ɔsaa abɔfra no yadeɛ, na ɔde no maa n’agya.
Yesu hyɛ ne yima ne ne wuo ho nkɔm
43Na Nyankopɔn ahoɔden kɛseɛ yi yɛɛ wɔn nyinaa ahodwiri. — Na nnoɔma a Yesu yɛeɛ no nyinaa yɛɛ wɔn nwanwa no, ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no sɛ: 44#Luk 9.22 Momma nsɛm yi nkɔ mo aso mu; na wɔrebɛyi onipa ba no ahyɛ nnipa nsa. 45#Luk 18.34 Na wɔante asɛm yi ase, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔde ahunta wɔn na wɔanhunu. Na wɔsuroo sɛ wɔbɛbisa no asɛm yi.
Ahobrɛaseɛ ne onuadɔ
(Mateo 18.1-5; Marko 9.33-40)
46Na asɛm bi baa wɔn mu sɛ wɔn mu hwan na ɔbɛyɛ kɛseɛ? 47Na Yesu hunuu wɔn akoma mu nsusuiɛ no, ɔfaa abɔfra bi bɛgyinaa ne nkyɛn, 48#Mat 10.40 na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Obiara a ɔbɛgye abɔfra yi me din mu no, wagye me; na obiara a ɔbɛgye me no, na wagye deɛ ɔsomaa me no. Na deɛ ɔyɛ mo nyinaa mu akumaa no, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ kɛseɛ. 49Na Yohane buaa sɛ: Owura, yɛhunuu sɛ obi de wo din retu ahonhommɔne; na yɛbaraa no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔne yɛn na ɛnam. 50#Luk 11.23; Flp 1.18 Na Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mommmara no! Na deɛ ɔnyɛ biribi ntia mo no na ɔwɔ mo afa.
Samariafoɔ atirimuɔdenfoɔ
51 # Mar 10.32 Na ɛbaa sɛ nna a wɔrebɛfa no akɔ ɔsoro reyɛ awie duru no, ɔde sii n’anim sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Yerusalem. 52#Yoh 4.4 Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ dii n’anim; na wɔkɔeɛ no, wɔkɔhyɛnee Samariafoɔ akuraa bi ase sɛ wɔrekɔsiesie hɔ ama no. 53Na wɔannye no, ɛfiri sɛ na n’ani kyerɛ Yerusalem. 54#2 Ah 1.10; 1.12 Na n’asuafoɔ Yakobo ne Yohane hunuiɛ no, wɔkaa sɛ: Awurade, wopɛ sɛ yɛka na ogya firi soro bɛhye wɔn? 55Na ɔdanee ne ho kaa wɔn anim.#9.55, 56 Tete Atwerɛfoɔ binom de ka ho sɛ: Monnim honhom ko a moyɛ ne dea? Onipa ba no amma ammɛsɛe nnipa akra, na mmom ɔbɛgyee wɔn. 56#Yoh 3.17; 12.47 Na wɔkɔɔ akuraa foforɔ bi ase.
Wɔn a wɔpɛ biribi ayɛ ansa na wɔadi Kristo akyire
(Mateo 8.19-22)
57Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔnam kwan mu rekorɔ no, obi ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Awurade, baabiara a wobɛkorɔ no, mɛdi w’akyi. 58Na Yesu see no sɛ: Nsakraman wɔ abɔn, na ewiem nnomaa wɔ mpirebuo; na Onipa Ba no deɛ, ɔnni deɛ ɔde ne tiri toɔ. 59Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔfoforɔ sɛ: Di m’akyi! Na ɔno deɛ ɔse: Ma me kwan na menkɔsie m’agya ansa. 60Na Yesu see no sɛ: Ma awufoɔ nsie wɔn awufoɔ, na wo deɛ, kɔ na kɔka Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm! 61#1 Ah 19.20 Na ɔfoforɔ nso kaa sɛ: Awurade, mɛdi w’akyi, na ma me kwan na menkɔkra wɔn a wɔwɔ me fie ansa. 62Na Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Obiara a ɔde ne nsa kɔsɔ funtumdadeɛ mu na ɔhwɛ n’akyire no mfata Nyankopɔn ahennie no mu.

Na Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mommmara no! Na deɛ ɔnyɛ biribi ntia mo no na ɔwɔ mo afa.

Na ɛbaa sɛ nna a wɔrebɛfa no akɔ ɔsoro reyɛ awie duru no, ɔde sii n’anim sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Yerusalem. Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ dii n’anim; na wɔkɔeɛ no, wɔkɔhyɛnee Samariafoɔ akuraa bi ase sɛ wɔrekɔsiesie hɔ ama no. Na wɔannye no, ɛfiri sɛ na n’ani kyerɛ Yerusalem. Na n’asuafoɔ Yakobo ne Yohane hunuiɛ no, wɔkaa sɛ: Awurade, wopɛ sɛ yɛka na ogya firi soro bɛhye wɔn? Na ɔdanee ne ho kaa wɔn anim. Na wɔkɔɔ akuraa foforɔ bi ase.


Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔnam kwan mu rekorɔ no, obi ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Awurade, baabiara a wobɛkorɔ no, mɛdi w’akyi. Na Yesu see no sɛ: Nsakraman wɔ abɔn, na ewiem nnomaa wɔ mpirebuo; na Onipa Ba no deɛ, ɔnni deɛ ɔde ne tiri toɔ. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔfoforɔ sɛ: Di m’akyi! Na ɔno deɛ ɔse: Ma me kwan na menkɔsie m’agya ansa. Na Yesu see no sɛ: Ma awufoɔ nsie wɔn awufoɔ, na wo deɛ, kɔ na kɔka Nyankopɔn ahennie ho asɛm! Na ɔfoforɔ nso kaa sɛ: Awurade, mɛdi w’akyi, na ma me kwan na menkɔkra wɔn a wɔwɔ me fie ansa. Na Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Obiara a ɔde ne nsa kɔsɔ funtumdadeɛ mu na ɔhwɛ n’akyire no mfata Nyankopɔn ahennie no mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!

app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
